structured_output.what_is_happening: This is a pump.fun token (migrated to PumpSwap) named after Extropic, the thermodynamic AI-chip startup whose CEO is Guillaume Verdon (@gillverd / "Beff Jezos"). The project description says "Fees to @gillverd via UsePaid", so it is a fee-sharing token that points creator fees at a public figure. Its linked X post comes from @DaliGambol (formerly DaliGambles), not from Verdon or Extropic. In the last hour it rose about 1000% (the ATH price implies roughly $114k market cap), and by T2 it was falling hard: -40% on DexScreener and -48% on GeckoTerminal over 5 minutes, with market cap down to about $46.5k. At least 10 copycat tokens named Extropic launched in the past ~2 hours. This pattern usually means a burst of attention from some trigger I could not see, possibly a reaction from Verdon, already being sold into.

narrative.description: A memecoin named after the real AI-hardware company Extropic, with creator fees routed to its CEO @gillverd through UsePaid. It rides e/acc and Beff Jezos culture. The company is real and active: it has a Sept 2026 research post and a reported $75M Department of Commerce deal. I found no crypto-specific news about this token.
narrative.why_spreading: Likely a trigger on X, such as Verdon acknowledging or claiming the fees. I could not verify this because X returned 402. Copycat launches and a 7x jump in 5-minute volume point to a sudden event, which is now fading.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is the earliest same-name token that is still liquid (created about 01:10 UTC), it has migrated, and it is the one with the UsePaid fee link to @gillverd. Most of the copycats are at about $3-15k market cap.
